notes.title: Version 1.0.4
notes.content:
This update continues to try to make the saves less likely to corrupt if a computer crashes or loses power.
- Game will create 5 backup saves.
- If the save is corrupted, will automatically attempt to load a backup

notes.title: Version 1.0.3
notes.content: [list][*][p]Fixed incorrect base damage display value for [spoiler]Spirit Sages[/spoiler][/p][/*][*][p]Locked blessings that are not in the next row to be unlocked will have their descriptions hidden[/p][/*][*][p]Added row selection highlighting for [spoiler]Dragon Abilities[/spoiler][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some rare cases when [spoiler]Druids and Sorcery[/spoiler] spirits would disappear[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where at a certain point you would get too many totems[/p][/*][*][p]Removed use of Unicode in the [spoiler]Cosmic Wall health[/spoiler] description[/p][/*][*][p]The game will now create a secondary backup file every time it is saved (located under C:\\Users\\<user>\\AppData\\Roaming\\Godot\\app_userdata\\Tower Wizard\\)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed skills not updating immediately when numeric notation was changed[/p][/*][*][p]Added a requirements button to [spoiler]The Observatory[/spoiler][/p][/*][*][p]Changed file extension of import file button to *.res[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Wizard Gnorps Bundle
notes.content: [p]I am honored to join (the) Gnorp Apologue in a bundle! It is one of the main inspirations for Tower Wizard, as some of you may have guessed.[/p][p][/p][p]If you wanted more incremental strategy gameplay similar to Tower Wizard and have not played (the) Gnorp Apologue yet, I highly recommend![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/55651/Wizard_Gnorps/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Version 1.0.2
notes.content: [p][b]This update is currently not applied yet, due to possible Steam Deck compat issues.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]- Fixed incorrect base damage display value for [spoiler]Spirit Sages[/spoiler][/p][p]- Locked blessings that are not in the next row to be unlocked will have their descriptions hidden[/p][p]- Added row selection highlighting for [spoiler]Dragon Abilities[/spoiler][/p][p]- Fixed some rare cases when [spoiler]Druids and Sorcery[/spoiler] spirits would disappear[/p][p]- Fixed issue where at a certain point you would get too many totems[/p][p]- Removed use of Unicode in the [spoiler]Cosmic Wall health[/spoiler] description[/p]

notes.title: Version 1.0.1
notes.content:
- Fixed Dragon tooltip not showing cost properly
- Added spoilers to key remapping
- Slightly reworded a couple of unclear blessings

Upcoming changes - these will be added/fixed in a future patch
- Reducing spoilers due to blessings
- Getting too many totems after a certain point

I will continue to note requests/issues to put in a larger patch, so do not hesitate to bring them up!

notes.title: Tower Wizard is now available!
notes.content: [p]After 8 months from the beginning as a tiny prototype, Tower Wizard is completed! Thanks for all of your support and feedback these last few months![/p][p][/p][p]The demo has been taken down, as it was a fairly old version. Saves from the demo should translate fine to the full version however.[/p][p][/p][p]Barribob[/p]

notes.title: Tower Wizard Releases June 19th!
notes.content:
Thanks for all of the support the last few months! Tower Wizard has grown quite a bit in that time, and I am excited to release it to a wider audience soon. There may be a few similarities to my previous game, Magic Archery, but overall it is a very different experience.

Of course there will be Steam achievements!

The initial release will be in just English for now.

That is all, hope to see you in a couple of weeks!

notes.title: Demo Patch 0.2.0
notes.content:
This is a minor patch resolving some issues.
- Minor re-balance of tower requirements
- Remove scroll bar in "Spirits" menu
- Fixed issue where you could unlock Milestone Blessings not present in the demo.

notes.title: Demo Patch 0.1.1
notes.content:
This is a minor patch resolving some issues.
- Added ability to move camera around using arrow keys/gamepad
- Game will enter full screen on first load
- Various changes balancing and progression speed
- Added a couple of missing graphics
- Reduce interfaces that use scrolling

notes.title: Demo now available!
notes.content:
For those that played the latest version of the Itch.io demo, the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3424330/Tower_Wizard_Demo/]Steam demo[/url] is similar in terms of content. It mostly has various quality of life improvements, balancing and bug fixes.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3424330/Tower_Wizard_Demo/

The Playtest will continue as a closed beta to test the latest changes and content. If you are interested in testing future content, the Playtest signup will remain available.

Thanks!

notes.title: Steam beta playtest coming soon!
notes.content:
For those of you interested in playing the game (in a less polished state) and giving feedback, the signup for the Playtest is available!

Note that this is different from the upcoming Demo, which is already available on Itch.io, and will be available on Steam sometime after the Playtest.

Likely within this week I will make the Playtest available to number of those who signed up.
